```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(highcharter)
library(DT)

wine <- read_csv("winemag-data-130k-v2.csv")
head(wine)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cap

wine %>% select(country, points, price, province, variety, title) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(str_extract(title, "\\d{4}"))) %>%
  select(-title) %>%
  datatable()
```
@tbl-cap Shows the overall wine quality in the world



```{r}
data(GNI2014, package = "treemap")

wine_points <- wine |>
    filter(!is.na(province), !is.na(price)) |>
    mutate(country = ifelse(country=="US", "United States", country)) |>
    mutate(country = ifelse(country=="Macedonia", "Macedonia, FYR", country)) |>
    mutate(country = ifelse(country=="Slovakia", "Slovak Republic", country)) |>
    mutate(country = ifelse(country=="England", "United Kingdom", country)) |>
    group_by(country) |>
    summarise(avg_points = mean(points), .groups = "drop") |>
    left_join(GNI2014 |> dplyr::select(iso3, country) |> distinct(), by = "country")

```


```{r}
#| label: fig-province-points
#| fig-height: 5
hcmap(map = "custom/world-robinson-lowres",
  download_map_data = getOption("highcharter.download_map_data"),
  data = wine_points,
  value = "avg_points",
  joinBy = c("iso-a3", "iso3")) |>
    hc_colorAxis(stops = color_stops(colors = viridisLite::inferno(10, begin = 0.1)))
```
@fig-province-points shows the average points by country.
